name: Altar
uniques: Can only be built to improve a resource <hidden from users>

civilopediaText.text: [Altar]s can be built by [Cleric]s on certain resources to provide stats different from the resource they would normally provide.
[Altar]s built on [Wine] and [Incense] are in celebration to the gods and increase [Culture].
[Altar]s built on [Wheat] and [Rice] are offerings of thanksgiving for a bountiful harvest and increase [Food].
[Altar]s built on [Goat]s and [Sheep] are atonement for sins and increase [Happiness].
